column1: # provision.tsv — the kv-v2 mounts and cert roles this release adds to a
# secrets store an earlier release initialised (geekdojo/geekdojo-brain#805;
# ADR-0010 S9). rasputin-store-provision.service reads it on every start of
# the store and adds, logged in as the store's provisioner, only what is
# missing. Nothing it finds present is changed, and nothing is ever removed.
# init.json beside this file is FROZEN from the store-arming release on: a
# store runs it once, on its first start, so an item added there would reach
# fresh stores only. A later release adds mounts and roles HERE, and a fresh
# store gets them here too, from the same provisioner, within its limits.
# The one exception is the audited job-id header request
# (geekdojo/geekdojo-brain#802), allowed by ADR-0010's amendment:
# https://github.com/geekdojo/geekdojo-brain/blob/main/projects/rasputin/adr/0010-secrets-store.md#the-initjson-job-header-exception-802
# One item per line, its fields separated by one TAB:
#   mount<TAB><name>               a kv-v2 mount at <name>
#   role<TAB><name><TAB><policy>   a cert role <name> trusting the store CA,
#                                  admitting only the CommonName <name>
# <name> matches ^rasputin-rel-[a-z0-9-]+$, and <policy> is rasputin-bindable,
# the one policy a provisioned role may bind. Anything else refuses the whole
# file, and the run is recorded failed. Lines starting with # and blank lines
# are skipped.
# This release adds nothing.
